name: Frog Stand
steps: Squat low on the floor with your knees spread wide and plant your hands flat on the ground shoulder-width apart with your fingers spread wide.
Bend your elbows slightly and wedge the insides of your knees firmly against the backs of your upper arms near your elbows.
Lean your weight slowly forward over your hands while bracing your core until your feet lift lightly off the floor.
Balance steadily on your hands for the target duration, then lower your feet gently back to the floor.
tips: Look slightly forward on the floor ahead of your fingertips rather than straight down to help maintain balance.
Press actively through your fingertips to stop yourself from tipping forward.
